title: MDPack manifest (mdpack.json), specification 0.2.0-draft
description: Structural schema for the manifest of an MDPack package. Extends 0.1 with the optional encryption member (profile mdpack-enc-1) and validates manifests written against 0.1 or 0.2. This schema is a convenience for tooling and cannot express every requirement of the specification: checksum correctness, byte lengths, the correspondence between declared assets and actual archive entries, and all payload-level (decrypted) rules require reading the container. Where this schema and the specification disagree, the specification governs.

version.description: Specification version the package was written against (§4.5). Encrypted packages (encryption member present) MUST use a 0.2 value.

entrypoint.description: Path of the entry document. Fixed in this version (§4.6); for encrypted packages it names the logical entry inside the encrypted payload (§13.2).

assets.description: Asset declarations; may be empty (§4.7). MUST be empty in an encrypted package (§13.2).

encryption.description: Presence switches the package to the encryption profile mdpack-enc-1 (§13). Must carry no unknown members in this version.

id.description: Stable package identifier (§5). Opaque and random — not user content, so unlike title/dates it MAY appear in an encrypted package.

title.description: Display name. Readers fall back to the file name without the extension. MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

description.description: Short human-readable summary. MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

createdAt.description: Creation time, RFC 3339 UTC with a Z suffix (§4.8). MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

modifiedAt.description: Last save time, RFC 3339 UTC with a Z suffix (§4.8). MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

generator.description: Application that last wrote the package. Diagnostics only. MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

markdownDialect.description: Declared Markdown dialect, used only as a rendering hint (§11.1). MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of document.md. Verified when present (§7). MUST NOT appear in an encrypted package (§13.2).

assetPath.description: Relative archive path under assets/. Rejects traversal, absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes (§4.7 and §8.2).

mediaType.description: Declared media type. Never trusted for rendering (§8.5).

bytes.description: Uncompressed length in bytes; verified against the archive entry (§4.7). In an encrypted package: plaintext length, verified after decryption (§13.6).

role.description: Descriptive usage hint. Unknown values are ignored, not rejected (§4.9).

originalName.description: Source file name, when the stored name had to be altered (§6.7).

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iteration count. Readers MUST reject values below 600000 (§13.2).

salt.description: Base64 (standard alphabet), 16-64 decoded bytes, fresh per package (§13.3).

payload.description: The archive entry carrying the encrypted payload (§13.4).
